description: This is the main activity source file for an Android application that interacts with the AccountManager API. It manages account updates, displays account information, and provides account selection functionality.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: The primary activity handling account management, user interface setup, and user interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up account management listeners, UI components, and welcome dialog.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Removes the account update listener to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result from account selection activity, providing user feedback via toast messages.
